segments.name: Marine fuel
segments.description: Provides one-stop vessel refueling bunkering facilitation, purchasing marine fuel and arranging delivery to ship operators across global ports.
segments.evidence: The Company is principally engaged in sales and distribution of marine fuel.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for vessel refueling on a cost-plus basis, earning a premium between selling price and purchase cost per metric ton of marine fuel.
revenueModel.evidence: we basically price our services on a "cost plus" basis, i.e., we are able to obtain a premium, being the difference between the selling price per metric ton of marine fuel sold to our customers and the purchase cost from our suppliers.
